title: Cylindrical strip: axial buckling
evidence_class: Analytical screening; finer extraction remains partial
description: Thin cylinder R=100 m, full length 200 m, t=1 m, E=210 GPa, nu=0.3; one 22.5-degree circumferential sector over half-length.
geometry: 18 nodes; 8 elements. Thin cylinder R=100 m, full length 200 m, t=1 m, E=210 GPa, nu=0.3; one 22.5-degree circumferential sector over half-length.
material: E=2.1e+11, nu=0.3; shell thickness=1. SI: m, N, kg, s, Pa
boundary_conditions: Cylindrical-frame symmetry and axial midpoint constraints; 1 Pa axial compression. The strip imposes axisymmetric deformation.
loading: Uniform 1 Pa reference axial compression; consistent edge forces sum to 39.270 in +Z on the strip end.

references.citation: Brush and Almroth, Buckling of Bars, Plates and Shells (1975), classical perfect-cylinder theory.
Hilburger, M.W. (2020). Buckling of Thin-Walled Circular Cylinders. NASA/SP-8007-2020/REV 2. Ideal theory is distinct from imperfection-sensitive test capacity.

observations: The qualified strip refinement is 16x4 (first-root error 0.537%). Finer 32x8 extraction attempts failed completeness checks: the retained five-of-six result is published as PARTIAL, with no certified global critical-root claim.
Finite strip boundary conditions differ from an unlimited ideal cylinder. The remaining discrepancy must not automatically be attributed entirely to mesh error.

The supplied input omitted SPC selection from the buckling subcase. This rerun explicitly adds SPC=1 to that subcase, preserving the intended constraints. The original failed attempt is retained in the audit record.
The figure shows the finest qualified companion; the table retains the supplied benchmark and available refinements. Each field dataset and binary file has its own input hash and run receipt.
limits: Only the first qualified buckling root is compared with ideal theory. The 32x8 spectrum remains unqualified; this is a finite axisymmetric screening model, not an experimental capacity prediction.
figure_caption: Recorded JFEM result; deformation is amplified, mode amplitudes/signs arbitrary. Green triangles mark constrained nodes; magenta arrows mark available point loads. Finest companion shown.
